name: Shimotsuma (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Shimotsuma city emblem in white: a stylised bird-like device with a curled stroke and a pointed wing.
history: Municipal flag of Shimotsuma, a city in Ibaraki Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 July 1954.

features.role: Shimotsuma city emblem — a stylised bird-like device with a curled stroke and a pointed wing
